composers_checked.name: Sammartini, Giovanni Battista
composers_checked.note: No Jenkins-Churgin work list was reachable; gap check against Wikipedia's counts (6 or 8 quintets, 7 concertinos, 21-27 flute quartets, about 177-200 string trios) and the Apple Music and MusicBrainz catalogues. Kept Op. 9 (complete Tactus recording); added two recorded quintets, concertini a 4 and Tactus trios without catalogue numbers (low confidence). Most trio sources are unrecorded.

composers_checked.name: Dall'Abaco, Evaristo Felice
composers_checked.note: Gap check against de.wikipedia (Passadore catalogue, discography): in scope only Op. 2 (left out as ripieno concertos, see note) and Op. 3; Op. 1 and 4 are duos, Op. 5 and 6 orchestral; manuscript Concertini PasD 10, 13 and Sinfonia a 4 PasD 14: no recording found.

note: (1) Dall'Abaco Op. 2 (12 'Concerti a quattro da chiesa', 2 vn, va, vc, bc) is left out as string orchestra: it is ripieno concerto repertoire and every recording found is by a directed band; Stylus Phantasticus (Accent ACC 24200) may play it one to a part. Same open question as c07's Albinoni Op. 2; if the owner rules such works in, Op. 2 gives 12 entries (complete recording: Il Tempio Armonico, Fra Bernardo 2020). (2) Sammartini Op. 9 Nos. 5 and 6 are identified with IMSLP's 'Flute Quartet in C/A major' pages (Karlsruhe manuscripts) by key, movements and length; Op. 9 Nos. 1, 2, 3, 6 were also printed c. 1750 as Le Clerc's Op. 5 Nos. 12, 11, 10, 9 (year from that print). (3) Sammartini gap works have no catalogue numbers (Aglàia's quintets and concertini, Tactus's trios); they may coincide with unrecorded IMSLP sources (IGS 25/26, Op. 5, Op. 7, J-C 83). Quintet scoring (3 violins, viola, cello) rests only on a search-result summary of a Médiathèque listing of Ensemble 415's 'Quintetto No. 3 in G' (harmonia mundi HMA 1951245; page unreachable when checked): confirm before publishing. That Quintetto No. 3 (Allegrino, Largo, Presto, 15:43) is not added: it may be Aglàia's No. 2 (Allegro, Largo, Presto, 16:26) under another number. (4) Not added: an unnumbered 'Notturno in A major' (Spiritoso, Minuetto) on the Tactus Op. 9 disc, and Camerata Köln's D-major sonata for flute, 2 violins and b.c. (Giuseppe or G. B.?). (5) Dall'Abaco Op. 3 cello: IMSLP says it doubles the continuo in Nos. 3 and 12; counted in the continuo throughout (3 players). Op. 3 No. 2's only recording is a 1930s Anthologie Sonore 78 (de.wikipedia). BY HAND (orchestrating session, 2026-10-17, on the owner's instruction to leave off lesser-known works that raise flags): 10 work(s) the agent kept at low confidence were moved to skipped (reason "doubtful") and parked in data/chamber/curation/parked-low-confidence.json: Sammartini: Concertino a 4 in G major; Sammartini: Concertino a 4 in E-flat major; Sammartini: Concertino a 4 in B-flat major; Sammartini: String Quintet No. 1 in G major; Sammartini: String Quintet No. 2 in G major; Sammartini: Trio Sonata in G major; Sammartini: Trio Sonata in A major; Sammartini: Trio Sonata in C major; Sammartini: Trio Sonata in G minor; Dall'Abaco: Trio Sonata in F major, Op. 3 No. 2.
